description: Use this when the user wants to find federal grants, search federal grants by eligibility, or build a grant pipeline tracker of open grant opportunities. Queries a live federal listing and returns XLSX and calendar downloads, up to 30 rows per page. Do not use for private foundation, state or local grants.

closing_after.description: Inclusive earliest closing date, e.g. 2026-10-21; defaults to today in America/New_York.

closing_before.description: Inclusive latest closing date, e.g. 2026-12-20; at most 730 days after today.

eligibility.description: Applicant types, e.g. ["nonprofit_501c3"]; unrestricted notices are included.

include_no_close_date.description: Keep rolling or undated notices, e.g. true; default true.

instruments.description: Funding instruments, e.g. ["G"] for grants or ["CA"] for cooperative agreements.

keyword.description: Words to search for, e.g. youth mentoring; quotes are removed.

match_all_words.description: Require all keyword words, e.g. true; default false matches any word.

max_results.description: Rows per page, e.g. 25; from 1 to 30.

page.description: Page number after screening and sorting, e.g. 1; from 1 to 20.

posted_within_days.description: Number of days since posting, e.g. 7 for a weekly scan.

statuses.description: Notice status, e.g. ["posted"]; defaults to posted and forecasted.

name: find_grant_opportunities
title: Find federal grant opportunities
